dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit high-contrast, light-gray perimeters with a sharp, linear gradient transition into dark-gray interior cores, most prominent in the central-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized, irregular dark pixel clusters (low-intensity blobs) concentrated primarily along the lower flank and the junction between the neck and dorsal-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli in the mid-flank form an elongated scalene triangle, while four distinct blobs near the anterior neck form an irregular quadrilateral arrangement.
